purpose: Compose translation mounts, center-to-center distance joints, slack center-distance limits and world-axis translation locks around one shared donor-core integration step with bounded convergence-aware pre/post stabilization.

properties.options: bounded pre/post family passes, per-family iteration counts and convergence tolerances

limitations: distance-limit range interiors remain intentionally slack
axis locks constrain a world-space x or y component and are not full prismatic/slider joints
fixed deterministic family order introduces ordering bias
conflicting constraints are bounded by pass counts and are not claimed to converge globally
no angular inertia, rotating local anchors, hinge, full slider/prismatic, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics
post-core projection can move bodies after donor-core contact evidence was generated

proves: four families share exactly one donor-core integration step
axis-lock position and velocity residuals participate in convergence
axis locks compose with guarded activity and component-isolation paths without a second donor-core step

truth.basis: The composer names ordering bias, translation-only scope, contact-evidence timing and the non-prismatic nature of axis locks.

agency.basis: Callers choose family data, bounded budgets and convergence tolerances explicitly.

continuity.basis: Axis locks are appended to the existing composer while the donor source and previous three family semantics remain preserved.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The integration reuses the bounded one-step composer rather than chaining standalone wrappers and accidentally integrating physics twice.
